sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog, kept in data/catalogs/walkplay.json

meta.notes: The vendor and product id pairs Walkplay's product catalog lists under SchemeNo20 (data/catalogs/walkplay.json; this match is generated from it, D51), followed by what only devicePEQ 0617f38 lists: the scheme's product ids under the five vendor ids the catalog never names (most of those pairs don't exist). A device with its own profile matches that instead of this group. Walkplay's app gives this scheme 10 bands of PK, LS, HP and LP, with no high shelf (Walkplay's web app hides it too); devicePEQ gives it 10 bands of PK only.
